messages:
alys-people-ops: Quick update: we've published a targeted change to benefits eligibility tied to seniority tiers (Tier A/B/C). This affects prorated child-care stipend and parental leave top-up. Managers please review the short summary and complete the ack by Thu. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/Seniority+Tier+Benefits

jordy-comp: FYI payroll mapping required: new columns "seniority_tier" and "leave_topup_pct". Can we get a sample export format to validate?

sam-legal: For UK/IE teams I've added wording about statutory parental leave overlay and data minimization for tier declarations. Also noted contractor exclusions. Diff on Confluence.

matt-eng-mgr: Manager Q: if we promote someone mid-cycle from Tier B to A, does the stipend backdate or start next payroll month?

alys-people-ops: Good question. Policy: promotions mid-payroll month will take effect from the next payroll period; managers can submit a retroactive exception request with business justification. Added form link to the summary.

nina-emea: Heads-up EMEA: local counsel wants to review France/DE language before we publish region-wide. Hold ack nudges for those geos until I confirm.

jordy-comp: Sample CSV wed like payroll to accept: employee_id,start_period,seniority_tier,leave_topup_pct,childcare_stipend
```
123400,2026-07, TierA,20,150
```

ack-bot: Assigned microlearning "Seniority Tier Benefits: Manager Acknowledgement" to managers with direct reports. Due: 2026-07-09. Tracking: https://training.redwood.com/assignments/tier-bens-2026

alys-people-ops: Action items (short): 1) Managers: review + ack, 2) Comp/payroll: confirm CSV mapping and add columns, 3) Legal: finalize EMEA addenda, 4) People Ops: publish FAQ and exception form. Ill post a summary in #people-ops tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
